source: Dallas City Code ch. 51P, Article 487 (City Attorney's codified article, April 2026)

sections.title: Legislative History
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-487.101. LEGISLATIVE HISTORY.

PD 487 was established by Ordinance No. 23271, passed by the Dallas City Council on September 24, 1997. Ordinance No. 23271 amended Ordinance No. 19455, Chapter 51A of the Dallas City Code, as amended. (Ord. Nos. 19455; 23271; 26042)

sections.title: Property Location And Size
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-487.102. PROPERTY LOCATION AND SIZE.

PD 487 is established on property generally bounded by Polk Street, the alley between Eighth Street and the abandoned right-of-way for Melba Street, Tyler Avenue, and the alley between Ninth Street and Tenth Street. The size of PD 487 is approximately 7.7 acres. (Ord. Nos. 23271; 26042)

sections.title: Definitions And Interpretations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-487.103. DEFINITIONS AND INTERPRETATIONS.

(a) Unless otherwise stated, the definitions and interpretations contained in Chapter 51A apply.

(b) Unless otherwise stated, all references to articles, divisions, or sections in this article refer to articles, divisions, or sections in Chapter 51A.

(c) This district is considered to be a residential zoning district.

(d) This district is divided into two areas: Area A and Area B, as shown on the conceptual plan (Exhibit 487A). (Ord. Nos. 23271; 26042)

sections.title: Conceptual Plan
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-487.104. CONCEPTUAL PLAN.

(a) For private school and child-care facility uses, development and use of the Property must comply with the conceptual plan. In the event of a conflict between the provisions of this article and the conceptual plan, the provisions of this article control.

(b) For all other permitted uses, Subsections 51A-4.702(c)(2) through (i), regarding submission of or amendments to a conceptual plan, development plan, site analysis plan, development schedule, or landscape plan, do not apply. (Ord. Nos. 23271; 26042)

sections.title: Development Plan
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-487.105. DEVELOPMENT PLAN.

For private school and child-care facility uses, a development plan for each phase of development must be approved by the city plan commission before the issuance of any building permit within that phase. No time limit exists for the submission of a development plan. (Ord. Nos. 23271; 26042)

sections.title: Main Uses Permitted
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-487.106. MAIN USES PERMITTED.

(a) Area A.

(1) Except as provided below, the uses allowed on the Property are all uses permitted in the R-5(A) Single Family District, subject to the same conditions applicable in the R-5(A) Single Family District, as set out in the Dallas Development Code. For example, a use permitted in the R-5(A) Single Family District by specific use permit (SUP) only is permitted in this PD by SUP. A use subject to development impact review (DIR) in the R-5(A) Single Family District is subject to DIR in this PD, etc.

(2) A private school and a child-care facility are permitted by right in this district.

(b) Area B.

(1) Except as provided below, the uses allowed on the Property are all uses permitted in the MF-3(A) Multifamily District, subject to the same conditions applicable in the MF-3(A) Multifamily District, as set out in the Dallas Development Code. For example, a use permitted in the MF- 3(A) Multifamily District by specific use permit (SUP) only is permitted in this PD by SUP. A use subject to development impact review (DIR) in the MF-3(A) Multifamily District is subject to DIR in this PD, etc.

(2) Surface parking, whether required or excess off-street parking, incidental to a private school, child-care facility, or church is permitted by right.

(3) A private recreation center, club, or area incidental to a private school, child-care facility, or church is permitted by right. (Ord Nos. 23271; 26042)

sections.title: Accessory Uses
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-487.107. ACCESSORY USES.

(a) As a general rule, an accessory use is permitted in any district in which the main use is permitted. Some specific types of accessory uses, however, due to their unique nature, are subject to additional regulations contained in Section 51A-4.217. For more information regarding accessory uses, consult Section 51A-4.217.

(b) The following accessory uses are not permitted in this district:

-- Accessory helistop. -- Accessory medical/infectious waste incinerator. -- Accessory outside display of merchandise. -- Accessory outside sales. -- Accessory pathological waste incinerator.

(c) In this district, the following accessory uses are permitted by SUP only:

-- Accessory community center (private). -- Amateur communication tower. (Ord. Nos. 23271; 26042)

sections.title: Yard, Lot, And Space Regulations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-487.108. YARD, LOT, AND SPACE REGULATIONS.

(Note: The yard, lot, and space regulations in this section must be read together with the yard, lot, and space regulations contained in Division 51A-4.400. In the event of a conflict between this section and Division 51A-4.400, this section controls.)

(a) In general. Unless otherwise stated, the yard, lot, and space regulations for the R-5(A) Single Family District contained in Section 51A-4.112(g)(4) apply to property located in Area A, and the yard, lot, and space regulations for the MF-3(A) Multifamily District contained in Section 51A- 4.116(c)(4) apply to property located in Area B.

(b) Height. Maximum structure height for a private school and a child-care facility in Area A is 40 feet.

(c) Lot coverage. Maximum lot coverage for a private school and a child-care facility in Area A is 40 percent. For purposes of lot coverage, Area A is considered to be one lot.

(d) Setbacks. Nonresidential structures may not be located within 120 feet of the northern property line of Area A, except for structures associated with outdoor recreational activities, including, but not limited to, athletic field goal posts and lights, playground equipment, and bleachers. (Ord. Nos. 23271; 26042)

sections.title: Off-Street Parking And Loading
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-487.109. OFF-STREET PARKING AND LOADING.

Consult the use regulations contained in Division 51A-4.200 for the specific off-street parking and loading requirements for each use. Consult the off-street parking and loading regulations (Division 51A-4.300) for information regarding off-street parking and loading generally. For purposes of shared or remote parking, as defined in Section 51-4.320, the private school and child-care facility uses located in Area A may use Area B for remote and shared parking. (Ord. Nos. 23271; 26042)

sections.title: Access
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-487.110. ACCESS.

Access to the alley north of Area A is prohibited for all nonresidential uses located on the Property. (Ord. Nos. 23271; 26042)

sections.title: Environmental Performance Standards
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-487.111. ENVIRONMENTAL PERFORMANCE STANDARDS.

See Article VI. (Ord. Nos. 23271; 26042)

sections.title: Landscaping
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-487.112. LANDSCAPING.

(a) Except as provided below, landscaping must be provided in accordance with Article X.

(b) All plant materials must be maintained in a healthy, growing condition.

(c) A minimum two-foot-wide perimeter landscaped buffer strip, consisting of solid evergreen hedges, is required along Polk Street adjacent to the existing parking lot, as shown on the conceptual plan. Subject to compliance with applicable licensing requirements, this perimeter landscaped buffer strip may be located within the street right-of-way, and is required in lieu of the buffer strip

required under Article X. A perimeter landscape buffer strip, as defined in Article X, is required along Tyler Street, adjacent to Area A. (Ord. Nos. 23271; 26042)

sections.title: Signs
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-487.113. SIGNS.

Signs must comply with the provisions for non-business zoning districts contained in Article VII. (Ord. Nos. 23271; 26042)

sections.title: Lighting
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-487.114. LIGHTING.

All outdoor lighting must be operational and maintained in accordance with the Dallas Development Code, and must be directed away from adjoining properties. (Ord. Nos. 23271; 26042)

sections.title: Hours Of Operation
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-487.115. HOURS OF OPERATION.

Except for recreational activities and other school related activities, including, but not limited to, parent/teacher meetings, carnivals, theatrical events, choral events, and other instrumental performances, the permitted hours of operation for a private school and a child-care facility are 6:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m., Monday through Friday. (Ord. Nos. 23271; 26042)

sections.title: Additional Provisions
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-487.116. ADDITIONAL PROVISIONS.

(a) The entire Property must be properly maintained in a state of good repair and neat appearance.

(b) Development and use of the Property must comply with all federal and state laws and regulations, and with all ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city. (Ord. Nos. 23271; 26042)

sections.title: General Requirements
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-487.117. GENERAL REQUIREMENTS.

(a) All paved areas, permanent drives, streets, and drainage structures, if any, must be constructed in accordance with standard city specifications, and completed to the satisfaction of the director of public works and transportation.

(b) The building official shall not issue a building permit or certificate of occupancy for a use in this PD until there has been full compliance with this article, the Dallas Development Code, the construction codes, and all other ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city. (Ord. Nos. 23271; 26042)

sections.title: Zoning Map
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-487.118. ZONING MAP.

PD 487 is located on Zoning Map No. L-6. (Ord. Nos. 23271; 26042)
